# Your account
## Reset your password
Click Forgot password on the sign-in page. We email a reset link that works for 30 minutes.

## Change your delivery address
You can change the address on an order until it is packed. After that, the address is locked.

## Delete your account
Go to Settings, then Privacy, then Delete account. We remove your personal data within 30 days, but keep invoices for 8 years as the law requires.

## Brightleaf Club points
You earn 1 point for every 100 rupees you spend. 100 points equal a 100 rupee discount on your next order.

Need more help? Our support team can help with orders, returns, refunds, shipping, delivery, payments, warranty claims and account questions. Write to help@brightleaf.example and we reply within one business day. Brightleaf Home is a made-up demo store.

# Payments
## Ways to pay
We accept UPI, debit cards, credit cards, net banking and cash on delivery.

## Cash on delivery limit
Cash on delivery is available only for orders below 10,000 rupees.

## No-cost EMI
Orders above 5,000 rupees can be split into 3 or 6 monthly instalments with no interest on selected credit cards.

## Payment failed but money was taken
If money left your account but the order was not placed, the bank reverses it automatically within 7 days. You do not need to contact us.

## GST invoice
Download a GST invoice from My Orders. To add your company GSTIN, enter it at checkout before you pay.

# Returns and refunds
## Return window
You can return most items within 30 days of delivery. The item must be unused and in its original box.

## How to start a return
Go to My Orders, pick the item and click Start a return. Print the free return label and drop the parcel at any partner courier point.

## When you get your money back
We send the refund to your original payment method within 5 business days after the item reaches our warehouse.

## Damaged or wrong items
If an item arrives broken or is not what you ordered, send a photo within 48 hours of delivery. We send a free replacement and you do not need to return the broken item.

## Items you cannot return
Mattresses, pillows and cut-to-size curtains cannot be returned once opened, for hygiene and custom-made reasons.

# Shipping and delivery
## Delivery times
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days in metro cities and up to 8 business days elsewhere.

## Express delivery
Express delivery arrives in 1 to 2 business days and costs a flat 199 rupees per order.

## Free shipping
Orders above 2,999 rupees ship free with standard delivery.

## Large furniture
Sofas, beds and wardrobes come by our own van team. They call you a day before to book a two-hour slot and carry the item to your room.

## Tracking your parcel
You get an SMS with a tracking link as soon as the parcel leaves our warehouse.

## Missed delivery
The courier tries three times. After the third missed attempt, the parcel comes back to us and we refund you minus the shipping fee.

# Warranty
## Furniture warranty
Wooden furniture has a 2-year warranty against cracks, loose joints and manufacturing faults.

## Lighting warranty
Lamps and LED lights have a 1-year warranty on the electrical parts.

## What the warranty does not cover
Normal wear, water damage, sun fading and damage from moving the item yourself are not covered.

## How to make a claim
Fill in the claim form on the Warranty page with your order number and photos. A technician visits within 7 days to repair or replace the item.
